#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        int len = std::stoi(line);
        std::string str;
        if (!std::getline(std::cin, str)) break;
        const int n = len;
        const char* array = str.c_str();

        int maxLength = 0;
        int wordsCount = 0;
        int currentCount = 0;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < n) {
            char ch = array[index];

            if (ch != '_' && ch != '(' && ch != ')') {
                currentCount++;
            } else if (ch == '_') {
                maxLength = std::max(maxLength, currentCount);
                currentCount = 0;
            } else if (ch == '(') {
                maxLength = std::max(maxLength, currentCount);
                currentCount = 0;
                index++;
                while (index < n && array[index] != ')' && array[index] != '_') {
                    if (array[index] != '_' && array[index] != '(' && array[index] != ')') {
                        currentCount++;
                    } else if (array[index] == '_') {
                        if (currentCount != 0) {
                            wordsCount++;
                            currentCount = 0;
                        }
                    } else if (array[index] == ')') {
                        if (currentCount != 0) {
                            wordsCount++;
                            currentCount = 0;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    index++;
                }
            }
            index++;
        }
        maxLength = std::max(maxLength, currentCount);
        std::cout << maxLength << " " << wordsCount << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
